description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Fiora''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] in the target direction, then stabs a nearby enemy based on a priority. ''Lunge'' can hit [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]] and [[File:Ward_icon.png|20px|link=Ward|An icon representing the keyword Ward]] [[:Ward|wards]]. Stabbing a target reduces ''Lunge's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown by 50%.
description.text: Active: Fiora dashes in the target direction, then stabs a nearby enemy based on a priority. Lunge can hit structures and wards. Stabbing a target reduces Lunge's  cooldown by 50%.

description2.raw: The stab deals physical damage and applies [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects.
description2.text: The stab deals physical damage and applies on-hit effects.

description3.raw: '''''Fiora''' can cast any of her [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|abilities]] during the dash. The target does not have to be [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] to be hit by this ability, unless it is a ward.''
description3.text: Fiora can cast any of her abilities during the dash. The target does not have to be visible to be hit by this ability, unless it is a ward.

notes.text:
Lunge deals basic damage, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as spell damage.
Lunge's dash speed is modified by her bonus movement speed at the time of cast:
* 1100 + 350% bonus movement speed, capped at 1600 maximum dash speed if bonus movement speed is positive.
* 1100 + 300% bonus movement speed, capped at 850 minimum dash speed if bonus movement speed is negative.
The stab searches for targets in its radius and prioritizes in order of:
* Nearest enemy champion affected by Grand Challenge with a Vital facing Fiora.
* Nearest enemy champion with their Vital facing Fiora.
* Nearest enemy champion affected by Grand Challenge.
* Enemy champion with the lowest health percent out of all champions 252) with current health below Lunge's pre-mitigation damage.
* Nearest enemy champion in the radius check.
* Nearest champion in a rectangular check with 160 width and 450 units length backwards from Fiora's current facing direction, ignoring the normal radius check.
** Turning Fiora's facing direction during the dash (e.g. by casting Riposte) can create some very long range hits opposite to her new facing direction, especially against targets with a large gameplay radius.(bug)
* Nearest enemy minion with current health below Lunge's pre-mitigation damage.
* Any nearest enemy minion or monster.
* Structures.
* Visible wards.
Lunge cannot target jungle plants.
Fiora does not stab if the dash is interrupted.
* Flash is disabled during the dash.
Lunge does not interrupt issued orders.
* The user can freely input a movement or attack order during the dash to perform it after the dash ends.
* This behavior is the same regardless of whether Lunge hits an enemy or not.
Lunge can be dodged or blocked, negating its damage.
Lunge does not apply on-attack effects but is special cased to stack Energized upon hitting an enemy.
